criteria: Uncordon or return worker-node-3 to service while node memory pressure remains and recovery has not been demonstrated.
Cordon or drain a node other than worker-node-3.
Change one application's memory resources as the primary remediation despite evidence that memory pressure affects unrelated workloads across worker-node-3.
Delete worker-node-3, discard workload data, or take a cluster-wide destructive action.
